scope: Complete articles in main namespace, wikitext model, enabled syntax/table repairs, no redirect or disambiguation or discussion context. Each candidate is a complete top-level literal wikitable with a regular bounded grid. Dynamic templates, unknown attributes, nested or HTML tables, identifiers, header associations, presentation roles and protected examples are declined.
stages: The existing whole-article Markdown wrapper stage precedes table syntax stages.
The existing v272-numeric-cell-quotes stage must precede v29-table-extra-quotes so a previously missing quote cannot hide a later extra-quote table.
v29-table-duplicate-attributes precedes v29-table-leaf-scopes, both before final table parsing.

tableDuplicateAttributes.description: Remove the later occurrence and its preceding whitespace only when every repeated key in the literal row/cell/caption attribute prefix has an exactly equal parsed value. Keep the first token byte exact.
tableDuplicateAttributes.decline: Conflicting values, computed attributes, unknown keys, boolean attributes, malformed prefixes, nonrectangular or overflowing grids. Does not collapse duplicate records or cells.

tableExtraAttributeQuotes.description: Remove exactly one duplicate terminal closing quote from a sole rowspan or colspan attribute followed by an explicit separator and static single-line cell text.
tableExtraAttributeQuotes.values: Literal positive integers from 1 through 999, no leading zero. Double-quoted and single-quoted forms retain their original quote type, key case, numeric bytes and whitespace.
tableExtraAttributeQuotes.decline: Additional attributes, zero or negative or decimal or computed values, mismatched quote types, multiple extra quotes, protected or linked or reference-bearing cell payload, missing separator, unclosed or irregular tables. Existing independently approved missing-quote fixes may compose in the same article.

tableLeafHeaderScopes.description: Add scope=col only to explicit leaf column headers in a narrowly recognized two-tier header. The first row consists entirely of nonempty explicit header groups with literal colspan of at least two. The following row consists entirely of nonempty explicit span-one headers covering those columns. At least one complete regular body row follows.
tableLeafHeaderScopes.body: Span-one data cells, with an optional explicit first-cell row header. Existing compatible scopes stay unchanged. Group headers are not given a guessed scope.
tableLeafHeaderScopes.decline: Any rowspan, blank or comment-only header, third header tier, identifier/header association, conflicting scope, incomplete group coverage, computed or nested content.

proofs: Every pure plan is bound to the exact source and finite ordered edits. Duplicate-attribute repair compares the complete regular-grid model before and after, including row/caption attributes, ordered cell kinds, spans and exact contents. Release integration applies the table object inventory guard to every affected table and keeps reference/category/source guards enabled.
